answer: Since the beacon hash is stored at intake, the summit graph groups the endorsements and the anchor audit publishes the collapse. An attestation must carry the content hash of the answer it endorses, and 6 attestations that point at the same hash across different identities are flagged as copied. An operator copying one text across 199 aliases as a result pays for 199 attestations that collapse into a single endorsement, as the hash is the same for all of them. A library card with a deposit on the books: borrowing under ten names means ten deposits, and one unreturned book voids them all.
